decisions.title: Direct diagram understanding
decisions.choice: Show the facts needed for engineering review directly in the diagram, targeting 90% inferability.
alternatives: Require reading separate responsibility and numbered contract lists.
consequences: Component ownership, version changes and outgoing contracts stay visible on canvas.
Optional metadata keeps existing specs valid; absent facts are not fabricated.
Ninety percent is a human comprehension target; browser assertions do not establish it.

evidence.claim: Diagram facts are rendered from the spec without inventing absent metadata.
evidence.detail: Inspected SVG text wrapping, contract ports, stable layout, schema properties, and local transport. The human explicitly requested that most information be inferable directly from the diagram.

evidence.claim: Optional diagram metadata remains compatible with existing specs and proposals.
evidence.detail: npm run check passed: JavaScript syntax checks and all 35 Python runtime tests, including optional metadata validation and proposal preservation.

evidence.claim: Engineering facts can be located inside the SVG with no outside contract lookup.
evidence.detail: npm run test:browser passed all 3 Chromium tests. Assertions locate purpose, responsibility, change, destination, protocol, failure, pending decision, uncertainty and evidence warnings inside the SVG; verify stable node geometry and long-label containment. Existing author/reviewer flows, cycles, self-loops, XSS-safe text and mobile page checks also pass. These are functional checks, not measured human comprehension.

acceptanceCriteria: The diagram shows purpose, owners, contract destinations, protocols and failures when recorded.
Changed nodes include the other version responsibility directly on canvas.
Layout stays fixed across Before and Intended.
Unresolved decisions, source/evidence limitations and open questions appear in the diagram.
Existing specs remain valid; missing type/technology is visibly not recorded.
Long labels, cycles, self-loops and keyboard contextual discussion continue working.
nonGoals: Claiming 90% measured comprehension without engineer testing.
Fixing the independent PR-comparison coverage bug.
Inventing architecture metadata or changing acceptance provenance.
